data.title: 12Go Data Shows 49% Rise in Thailand Multimodal Travel Bookings, Revealing the Top 5 Routes
data.description: Thailand's islands are increasingly being reached through multimodal journeys, as travellers combine buses, minivans, ferries and — less often — trains and flights to create multi-stop trips, according to travel booking platform 12Go.

data.title: Ex-minister given death sentence for murder of adopted son
data.description: The Criminal Court has sentenced former cabinet minister Soonthorn Vilawan, 87, to death for the murder of a Prachin Buri councillor who was his adopted son. The sentence was commuted to life imprisonment.

data.title: One Bangkok joins Bangkok Climate Action Week 2026 as principal venue partner
data.description: One Bangkok is participating in Bangkok Climate Action Week 2026 and is set to host a range of activities from 5 to 7 October 2026. Positioning itself as a dynamic “Living Classroom”, One Bangkok aims to bridge sustainability principles with real-world practices, fostering greater awareness and understanding of climate action among the public.

data.title: TCG Launches "Nano Plus" to Support Over 100,000 Micro SMEs
data.description: Dr. Ekniti Nitithanprapas, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance, presided over the launch of the Nano Plus Loan Guarantee Programme and delivered a keynote address titled “Financial Opportunities for Small Businesses.” Also attending were Mr. Lawaron Saengsanit, Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Finance; Ms. Jindarat Viriyataweekul, Chairwoman of the Board of Directors of the Thai Credit Guarantee Corporation (TCG); representatives of state financial institutions; executives from Non-Bank institutions providing nano-finance services; and public and private sector partners. The event was held at the Kumpanthong Room, 21st Floor, 150th Anniversary Building, Ministry of Finance, on 22 September 2026.

data.title: S-Pure Eggs Earns First 'Thai Golden Eggs' Certification for Zero Salmonella
data.description: Bangkok – 24 September 2026 – S-Pure, a super-premium food brand produced by Betagro Public Company Limited (BTG), has earned the ‘Thai Golden Eggs’ certification by the Department of Livestock Development, making it Thailand’s first and only brand recognised for exceptional freshness, strict Salmonella-free standards, and superior breeder selection. This milestone reaffirms Betagro’s commitment to delivering ‘better food’ with uncompromised S-Class quality.
